# Blade Runner Insight

> In-depth analytical perspectives on Ridley Scott's Blade Runner

https://www.br-insight.com — essays of in-depth Blade Runner analysis,
organized by category and tag under /topics/.

## Essays

- [Love Letter to a Human from a Replicant](https://www.br-insight.com/library/love-letter/): My love. My one love. My only true love.
- [How Science Became God in Blade Runner](https://www.br-insight.com/library/how-science-became-god/): In one of the most acclaimed science fiction movies of all time, Ridley Scott presents us with a beautiful and scary vision of the future.
- [The World 2019 - A Worn Down Hell](https://www.br-insight.com/library/worn-down-hell/): Director Ridley Scott's mesmerising imagery conveys an age of fear and despair, apathy and alienation - a future without a future.
- [Picturing the Human](https://www.br-insight.com/library/picturing-the-human/): It would seem advisable to begin this interpretation of the film with an uncontroversial claim, so let us note at the outset that Blade Runner is explicitly…
- [A Study of Ridley Scott's Blade Runner](https://www.br-insight.com/library/a-study-of-blade-runner/): This dissertation was written between September 1997 and February 1998, and formed part of the final examination for my undergraduate degree in English…
- [Analysis of an Itch](https://www.br-insight.com/library/analysis-of-an-itch/): Blade Runner, directed by Ridley Scott, is brimming with symbolism. Each symbol can be correlated with the many different themes throughout the movie.
- [The Measure of a Man](https://www.br-insight.com/library/measure-of-a-man/): Historically, sentience has been fairly easy to define. Humans are sentient; animals are not.
- [Genealogy of Abdul Ben Hassan](https://www.br-insight.com/library/genealogy-of-abdul-ben-hassan/): Blade Runner (Scott, 82/92) a complex film with many underlying themes. One of these themes is the issue of race.
- [The Replicant I Used to Know](https://www.br-insight.com/library/replicant-i-used-to-know/): Recently, director Ridley Scott decieded to officially declare Rick Deckard a replicant. The rafters rang with mirth in the replicant ghetto on the net!
- [How & Why the Movie is Different](https://www.br-insight.com/library/how-and-why-movie-is-different/): Writers often choose a situation specifically to illustrate their points, but a very similar premise can be used to prove either side of an argument with equal…
- [Blade Runner Demystified](https://www.br-insight.com/library/br-demystified/): Blade Runner's narrative begins before the film starts, with the aid of a written account of events which occurred during the year 2000 - 2017.
- [Appreciation & Assessment of Dir. Cut](https://www.br-insight.com/library/appreciation-assessment-of-dircut/): This film deserves a higher status than that of cult, and is much more than just an acceptable homage to Philip K Dick, author of many original science-fiction…
- [Blade Runner - a Postmodernist View](https://www.br-insight.com/library/postmodernist-view/): The Postmodern reply to the Modern consists of recognizing that the past, since it cannot be destroyed, because it's destruction leads to silence, must be…
- [The City, Eyes and Christ](https://www.br-insight.com/library/city-eyes-and-christ/): When Blade Runner came out in 1982, it dazzled audiences with its representation of humanity's fallen social and technological structure.
- [Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? - No Really, Do They?](https://www.br-insight.com/library/do-androids-dream/): Philip K. Dick's book "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep" is an all time science fiction classic, actualised by the screen adaptation "Blade Runner".
- [AboutFilm.com's Analysis of Blade Runner](https://www.br-insight.com/library/aboutfilm-analysis/): Like most of the best science fiction, Blade Runner is not really concerned with pseudo-scientific gobbledy-gook.
- [What Defines Human?](https://www.br-insight.com/library/what-defines-human/): What if a nuclear war made the world virtually uninhabitable? What if science produced a robot, physicaly indistinguishable from human beings?
- [The Least Scary Option](https://www.br-insight.com/library/least-scary-option/): How and why does Blade Runner, a film about the future L.A., image that city in terms of the New York modernist metropolis?
- [Humans & Technology: What Separates Them?](https://www.br-insight.com/library/humans-and-technology/): The movie Blade Runner (1982) is loaded with contrasts and contradictions, and at the same exotic and typical of it's time.
- [Blade Runner, a Science-Fiction Movie?](https://www.br-insight.com/library/br-a-sf-movie/): In the movie industry today, it is hard to place movies into one single classification.
- [An Analysis of Blade Runner](https://www.br-insight.com/library/an-analysis-of-blade-runner/): Welcome to 21st century earth. The firmament flashes with belching mushroom clouds of fire and smoke.
- [What is the Significance of the Unicorn?](https://www.br-insight.com/library/significance-of-the-unicorn/): When Deckard leaves his apartment with Rachael at the end of the film, she knocks over an origami unicorn.
- [An Analysis of a Science-Fiction Movie](https://www.br-insight.com/library/analysis-of-a-sf-movie/): All movies must follow criteria that typifies them into a specific genre of film. For example, a romantic movie must create a chemistry between two characters.
- [Science-Fiction with an Angle](https://www.br-insight.com/library/sf-with-an-angle/): Bladerunner is a science fiction film that is focused on the human struggle for identity.
- [Blade Runner: an Analysis](https://www.br-insight.com/library/br-an-analysis/): Bladerunner is a cult classic Science Fiction film. What is a Science Fiction Film you ask? What makes Bladerunner a Science Fiction film?
- [Christian Symbolism](https://www.br-insight.com/library/christian-symbolism/): This paper was originally written for a Science Fiction in the Cinema class in 1991.
- [The Parting of the Mist](https://www.br-insight.com/library/parting-of-the-mist/): The conflict between the blade runner Deckard and the off world replicants is the central force of Ridley Scott's Blade Runner.
- [Deckard's Identity Debate](https://www.br-insight.com/library/deckards-identity-debate/): Ever since the movie was released, people watching it has been divided in two; those who believe Deckard being a replicant and those contrary to that belief.
- [Editor's Article](https://www.br-insight.com/library/editors-article/): The launch of Blade Runner Director's Cut in 1992 provoked many discussions on which version was the original version, and what the differences was.
